scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us when choosing a board game for game night: playtime, complexity, or social interaction?

options.name: Settlers of Catan
options.tradeoff: Can be lengthy and may not be suitable for all 5 players.
options.concern: Some players might find the gameplay too complex.
options.best_for: Groups that enjoy strategic planning and negotiation.

options.name: Ticket to Ride
options.upside: Easy to learn and plays quickly.
options.tradeoff: Less social interaction compared to other games.
options.concern: Some players might find it too simplistic.
options.best_for: Groups looking for a quick, accessible game.

options.name: Pandemic
options.tradeoff: Can be very challenging, leading to frustration.
options.concern: Not suitable for 5 players and requires cooperation.
options.best_for: Groups that enjoy cooperative gameplay and puzzles.

options.name: Codenames
options.tradeoff: Games are relatively short and may not fill the entire evening.
options.concern: Requires a good balance of word association skills among players.
options.best_for: Large groups looking for a light-hearted, entertaining experience.
